name: Knuckscorer
description: Throw the jab and rear cross in one chain, the second brass landing where the first drew the guard.

name: Brawlcurl
description: Slip a half step off the line between two linked blows so the opponent's counter finds only air.

name: Studscreen
description: Hold the fists high between blows of the chain so every opening is covered by brass.

name: Slabbuckle
description: Drop the elbow to check a body blow, then bring the brass straight back up into the chain.

name: Studscorer
description: Run jab, hook and cross together on a steady thread of qi so each blow lands before the guard resets.

name: Gagging Brassring
description: Tie qi into the brass of a hooked blow so it knocks the raised arm aside and opens the line.

name: Wild Fistbar
description: Open with a feinting jab that draws the guard up and sets the brass for the blows behind it.

name: Rugged Haymaker
description: Follow the opening jab at once with a rear cross that rides the same line to the chin.

name: Shielding Bandarch
description: Lift the rear hand to check a counter-jab and slip the head to its outside.

name: Overhand Stalk
description: Shuffle the lead foot forward under cover of the fists to bring the opponent into range.

name: Guarding Studplate
description: Stand tall behind high fists and let a gentle flow of qi keep the forearms steady against blows.

name: Cruel Ringband
description: Throw four blows in quick order, each fed by a fresh pulse of qi into the brass.

name: Brawlbarrier
description: Finish the run by pivoting and rapping the brass on the opponent's arm, jolting their guard apart.

name: Stern Uppercut
description: Drop the weight on the count of one and jab so the brass lands with the whole body behind it.

name: Brisk Handfill
description: Plant a slow step and swing the rear cross through on the second beat of the count.

name: Wild Hooking
description: Hold an even tempo and bring the looping hook on the third beat, each blow the same weight.

name: Stalwart Brassrim
description: Knock an incoming fist aside a half-beat early so its rhythm stumbles and the exchange resets.

name: Brawlswerve
description: Move the feet on the off-beat to change the distance just as the opponent commits.

name: Rigid Knuckleridge
description: Rock slowly behind the covering fists while the forearms take each blow on the beat.

name: Swift Brawl
description: Break the even rhythm with a sudden qi-backed hook on the pause where the opponent expects nothing.

name: Lassoing Ringband
description: Rap the brass on the opponent's lead hand with a pulse of qi to scatter their timing.

name: Rude Knockout
description: Step into the opponent's space as the jab goes out so they cannot reset their distance.

name: Brisk Palmbar
description: Drive the rear cross along the inside line of the opponent's arm to the point of the chin.

name: Discord Overhand
description: Ram the brass-wrapped forearm into the opponent's chest and lean to rob them of footing.

name: Clayring
description: Slip a shoulder under the opponent's counter and step out round it to the open side.

name: Regimen Handfill
description: Curl in behind both fists and elbows to form a shell the opponent's blows slide off.

name: Rillstud
description: Catch a punch on the brass and draw the opponent's arm inward, pulling them off balance.

name: Crimson Studplate
description: Throw a dense flurry of short blows at the ribs and jaw, each given qi from a tight stance.

name: Sleet Knockout
description: Lean the shoulder across the opponent's lead arm and hold it against the chest with braced, qi-fed forearms.

name: Hooking Hurdle
description: Slide through the gap beside the opponent's arm and land a qi-backed hook as the step ends.

name: Brawlswat
description: Jab lightly at the edge of the guard to learn where it leaves a gap.

name: Draught Brawl
description: Bring the brass down on the opponent's forearm like a hammer until the guard drops.

name: Gall Palmbar
description: Hook the ring over a raised arm and drag it down to uncover the face.

name: Studswat
description: Wedge the raised boss into the seam between the opponent's forearms and push them apart.

name: Springing Fistbar
description: Follow the wedge with a short step so the shoulders square up inside the guard.

name: Poisestud
description: Pin the opponent's striking elbow against their ribs with the brass and turn the blow aside.

name: Clay Brassrim
description: Pull the fists back to the cheeks after the break and hold the cover while the stance resets.

name: Gleamring
description: Charge the boss with qi and drive it into the seam of the guard so the point bores through.

name: Entangling Knuckleplate
description: Rap both fists against the opponent's forearms in quick succession and spring the guard open.

name: Brawn Brassring
description: Whip the fist down onto the crown of a lowered guard with qi packed into the brass.

name: Brawn Knuckleplate
description: Let the opponent's jab pass the shoulder, then answer with a rear cross over the top.

name: Veering Fistbar
description: Slip the head off the line and return the brass to the exposed ribs in the same turn.

name: Haze Knuckleridge
description: Turn the outer forearm against an incoming blow so the brass rides it away from the head.

name: Knuckbuckle
description: Roll the shoulders behind high fists and wait for the opponent to overreach.

name: Hum Uppercut
description: Leave the lead hand low as bait, then tap down on the arm that rises to take it.

name: Ember Hooking
description: Meet the opponent's advance with a straight punch fed by a pulse of qi at the instant they step.

name: Clutching Haymaker
description: Dip the lead brass low to draw the eyes down, then hook the rear fist to the head.

name: Keen Brawl
description: Run the raised boss along the line of the opponent's collar until it finds a soft spot.

name: Bandarch Scorer
description: Roll the shoulder forward behind the jab so the boss lands as a single hard point.

name: Dense Brassrim
description: Let an incoming fist slip along the boss and off to the side, then draw the hand back.

name: Regimen Ringband
description: Hold both bosses forward at chest height so any blow meets a point first.

name: Grit Haymaker
description: Take a short step along the line of the boss so the point stays aimed at the target.

name: Binding Bandarch
description: Rap the boss on the bony back of the opponent's hand and make their fingers open.

name: Acrid Uppercut
description: Set qi into the boss and drive it forward so the single point bores through leather or cloth.

name: Brassslab
description: Seat the charged boss between two ribs and twist the wrist to rob the opponent of breath.

name: Crimson Knuckleplate
description: Roll the shoulders as the jab leaves so the ring turns over and strikes with a rotating snap.

name: Honedring
description: Wheel the hook round into the rear cross without pause so the fists chase each other.

name: Padded Handfill
description: Roll the body under a swinging arm and push it up and away with the brass.

name: Knockout Swerve
description: Turn on the lead foot in a small wheel that carries the body clear of a charge.

name: Shardknuck
description: Keep the covering fists turning in small circles before the face so blows glance off them.

name: Hum Brassring
description: Spin the ring against the back of the opponent's wrist to knock the arm out of line.

name: Emberbrawl
description: Carry a qi pulse through the full wheel of jab, hook and cross so every ring lands harder.

name: Scudding Palmbar
description: Roll beneath the opponent's guard and come up inside it with a qi-backed uppercut.

name: Brawlbuckle
description: Spin a pulse of qi into the ring and tap the opponent's elbow so their stance turns and breaks.
